testcase.name: a StrictMode violation on the policy's thread reaches the log with its stack
install writes a process-start line, and recordSweep the count with it
a declined reapply records its reason and the tag the file carries
a failed reapply records the throwable and its stack as the entry's detail
a repeat of the same stack is one line with a count, not a second stack
a path that attempts no reapply records an entry of its own
recordCaptureShot writes the shot's five values as one entry, the display rotation beside the sensor's
a full StrictMode batch drops later violations, and the reset restores delivery
